env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-all

cd m
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=2 '"rule_id":"correctness::typed_nil_return"'
stderr -count=1 '"file":"[^"]*q/q\.go"'
stderr -count=1 '"file":"[^"]*p/p\.go"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'
! logos lint ./...
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
stderr -count=1 'q/q\.go:\d+:\d+: \[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
stderr -count=1 'p/p\.go:\d+:\d+: \[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
stderr -count=1 '# example.com/purelint/q'
stderr -count=1 '# example.com/purelint/p'
! stderr 'exit status'
logos build ./...
! stderr 'typed_nil_return'

env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-p
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./p
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"correctness::typed_nil_return"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*p/p\.go"'
! stderr '"file":"[^"]*q/q\.go"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'

cd ../warn
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-warn-json
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"perf::time_after_in_loop"'
stderr '"severity":"warn"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*q/q\.go"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-warn-text
logos lint ./...
stderr -count=1 'warning: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\]'
! stderr 'exit status'

cd ../lgo
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-lgo
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=1 '\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"correctness::typed_nil_return"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=1 '\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/purelint

go 1.27

-- m/p/p.go --
package p

import "example.com/purelint/q"

var Bad = q.Bad

type T struct{}
func OwnBad() any { return (*T)(nil) }

-- m/q/q.go --
package q

type T struct{}
func Bad() any { return (*T)(nil) }

-- warn/go.mod --
module example.com/warnlint

go 1.27

-- warn/p/p.go --
package p

import "example.com/warnlint/q"

var Wait = q.Wait

-- warn/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

func Wait(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) {
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		select {
		case <-time.After(d):
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		}
	}
}

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/lgolint

go 1.27

-- lgo/p/p.lgo --
package p

import "example.com/lgolint/q"

var Bad = q.Bad

-- lgo/q/q.lgo --
package q

type T struct{}
func Bad() any { return (*T)(nil) }
